lignes.texte: Your drivers. Your union. Shared income. Bab Taxi is built with the unions, not without them.
For your members: more rides, the full meter fare for themselves, blocked seats compensated, a share of advertising, a monthly quality bonus, and an SOS button.
Every driver sees in “My earnings” what Bab Taxi adds for him, day after day.
And your union earns too: a share of the advertising shown in your members' taxis, and a bonus for every active driver you bring on board. Every month, a clear statement.
Your role: inform your members, organise sign-up days, and pass on needs from the ground. The more your members drive with Bab Taxi, the more your union earns.
Our commitments: licensed taxis only, never private cars, no commission on the meter, and regular dialogue with the unions.
Bab Taxi, the taxi app. Taxi unions, become our partners from launch in Casablanca.
